in_sanskrit.name: Baraiya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baraiya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Baraiya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Barhini', which means the goddess of prosperity and wealth. She is known to bring abundance and success in all aspects of life.
